open_points.subject: Status — Required tests witness binding
open_points.text: Each Required tests item is bound to the check that witnesses it.
open_points.question: Must the witness be a check executed against the generated service, or may it be any existing verification, static, factory-gate, or document check that asserts the invariant?
options: The check must exercise the generated service.
Any executable verification check that asserts the invariant is sufficient.
A static or factory-gate check is also sufficient.
open_points.default_guess: Require an executable verification check that exercises the generated behavior.

open_points.subject: A11 — representation of photo_date
open_points.text: a project holding only dates without an offset passes.
open_points.question: Exactly which representations count as dates without an offset, especially whether a value ending in Z belongs to that class and whether malformed or non-ISO date strings pass?
options: Only valid offset-free date representations pass; Z and explicit ±HH:MM forms do not.
Z counts as offset-free because it has no explicit signed offset and therefore passes.
Every string not ending in Z or ±HH:MM passes, including malformed values.
open_points.default_guess: Only valid offset-free representations pass; Z is an old date and malformed values refuse delivery.

witness.initial: The Portal staff photo list contains a photo_date ending in Z.
events: The calling flow reads the project's staff photo list before placing anything.
The flow applies the old-date rule and the Required tests statement that dates without an offset pass.
outcomes: The Z value is an old date, so the flow places and publishes nothing and tells the owner.
The Z value is treated as having no explicit signed offset, so the old-date check passes and the flow may continue.
witness.observer: The owner and anyone observing whether the project receives a delivery.

open_points.subject: A11 INV-17 Required tests
open_points.text: INV-17: a project holding a date with an offset is detected before delivery, and a project holding only dates without an offset passes.
open_points.question: Must the witness separately show refusal for both old-date representations defined by the normative rule—Z and explicit +HH:MM or -HH:MM—or is one offset example sufficient to assert INV-17?
options: Test Z, positive offset, and negative offset separately.
Test one explicit signed-offset example only.
Test any one old-date representation, including Z.
open_points.default_guess: Test Z and both signed-offset directions, plus a valid offset-free passing case.

open_points.subject: A11 INV-17 Required tests
open_points.text: a project holding only dates without an offset passes.
open_points.question: What observable result must the passing case demonstrate: only that the old-date gate permits continuation, or that placement and publication complete successfully?
options: Assert only that the old-date gate permits the flow to continue.
Assert that placement and publication complete.
Assert continuation, while allowing later independent checks to refuse delivery.
open_points.default_guess: Assert that this gate permits continuation while allowing unrelated later checks to refuse delivery.

witness.initial: A project has a readable staff photo list containing only valid offset-free dates, but a later independent delivery precondition fails.
events: The calling flow performs the A11 old-date check.
The flow reaches the later failing precondition.
outcomes: The A11 passing test succeeds because the flow passed this gate and continued.
The A11 passing test fails because no photo was ultimately placed and published.
witness.observer: The verification suite and its maintainer.

open_points.subject: A11 INV-17 Required tests
open_points.text: The calling flow's own stop is shown when that flow exists.
open_points.question: If no concrete calling flow exists when the witness is implemented, what must the witness show for INV-17, and what later event makes the flow-specific stop evidence mandatory?
options: The witness may omit stop behavior permanently when no flow exists.
Use a contract-level or harness flow now, then add a flow-specific assertion when a flow is introduced.
INV-17 cannot be accepted until a concrete calling flow exists and its stop is shown.
open_points.default_guess: Use a contract-level harness now and require a flow-specific assertion as soon as a calling flow is introduced.

witness.initial: The invariant and witness identifier exist, but no concrete calling-flow implementation exists yet.
events: A concrete calling flow is added later.
outcomes: The original witness remains sufficient and the new flow's stop is never tested.
The new flow makes an additional stop assertion mandatory.
witness.observer: Later implementers and the verification suite.

open_points.subject: A11 INV-17 Required tests
open_points.question: Which prohibited effects must the witness assert are absent when an old date is detected: publication only, both placement and publication, or every operation considered part of delivery?
options: Assert only that no delivered photo is published, matching INV-17.
Assert that neither placement nor publication occurs, matching the normative refusal rule.
Assert that no delivery-related mutation of any kind occurs.
open_points.default_guess: Assert that neither placement nor publication occurs.

witness.initial: A project contains a photo_date with an explicit +HH:MM offset.
events: The calling flow detects the old date.
An implementation stages or places a photo but does not publish it.
outcomes: The witness passes because no photo was published and detection occurred before completed delivery.
The witness fails because the rule requires that nothing be placed or published.
witness.observer: The project owner and the verification suite.
